signature: NTSTATUS WINAPI BCryptEncrypt(BCRYPT_KEY_HANDLE hKey, PUCHAR pbInput, ULONG cbInput, void *pPaddingInfo, PUCHAR pbIV, ULONG cbIV, PUCHAR pbOutput, ULONG cbOutput, ULONG *pcbResult, ULONG dwFlags)
empirical_windows_behavior: Supports AES-ECB, AES-CBC (mutating pbIV in-place to the final ciphertext block), PKCS#7 BCRYPT_BLOCK_PADDING (0x00000001), AES-GCM via BCRYPT_AUTHENTICATED_CIPHER_MODE_INFO, and raw RSA BCRYPT_PAD_NONE (0x00000001).
When pbOutput == NULL, sets *pcbResult to required output size and returns STATUS_SUCCESS.
macos_backend_strategy: Use Apple CommonCrypto (CCCrypt) on __APPLE__ and big-integer modular exponentiation for BCRYPT_PAD_NONE RSA.
